newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 1.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 1.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:

* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 46.96 points to close at 7,008.99, a day after soaring 179 points in its second largest point gain ever on fresh signs of solid economic growth with modest inflation.
* The capital market supervisory agency (Bapepam) has issued new regulations on margin trading and mutual funds in a bid to improve protection for investors and boost market efficiency.
* On Wednesday, the composite index rose 4.82 points to close at 652.05 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,432.75/33.50 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.00/31.00.
* Shipping firm Berlian following active trading on Wednesday due to market talk that the firm had possibly secured a large loan to expand business.
* Astra on a newspaper report the automobile conglomerate planned to produce sedans priced between 35 million to 40 million rupiah each.
* Property firm Elang after reports Bakrie Group, which has a majority stake in Elang, planned to put its property projects under Elang.
* Finance firm Multidana following heavy trading volumes on Wednesday.
